WANTED - DEAD OR ALIVE

%1

Wanted for looting the Rosewood depot and for killing two of our own.

UI_BEP_TQW_Note2Body:
Mom:

If you're reading this, someone found me before you did.
We're not the monsters they talk about on the radio. At first we just wanted food.
After what happened at the farm... I don't know what we are anymore.

Don't come looking for me.

%1
UI_BEP_TQW_Note3Body:
STANDING ORDER - READ AND BURN

1. No one enters the perimeter without the password.
2. The wounded stay behind. No exceptions.
3. If one of us falls, call it in on the radio and regroup. Do NOT give chase.
4. Whoever abandons their post answers to me.

Signed: %1
UI_BEP_TQW_Note4Body:
WHAT THEY OWE ME:

- Vic: 200 rounds of .308. Dead. Collected.
- Marta: the shotgun. Took off up north.
- The new guy: nothing yet. Good aim, though.
- %1 (me): a shot to the knee I took covering all of them.

Nobody ever pays up.
